title: A cultural stroll through Paris with actors François-Xavier Demaison and François Morel
summary: This week, we bring you a special programme dedicated to theatre. Valérie Fayolle takes us to the Renaissance Theatre, where François-Xavier Demaison takes us behind the scenes of "Laponie".
